name: T-NBOMe
summary: T-NBOMe, or TNBOMe, also known as NBOMe-T, NBOMe-tryptamine, or N-(2-methoxybenzyl)tryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator and possible psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family. It is the N-(2-methoxybenzyl) derivative of tryptamine.

pharmacology.text: T-NBOMe, or TNBOMe, also known as NBOMe-T, NBOMe-tryptamine, or N-(2-methoxybenzyl)tryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator and possible psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family. The drug shows affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2 receptors, including for the serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors (Ki = 89 nM, 47 nM, and 224 nM, respectively).
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Possible psychedelic drug

uses.text: It emerged as a novel designer drug by early 2024.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people, as it appeared as a designer drug only recently. The phenethylamine NBOMes, which carry the same group, have caused seizures, dangerous overheating and deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 由於它最近才以設計師藥物的形式出現，目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。帶有相同基團的苯乙胺類NBOMe藥物曾造成癲癇發作、危險的體溫過高與死亡。
sideEffects.zhHans: 由于它最近才以设计师药物的形式出现，目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。带有相同基团的苯乙胺类NBOMe药物曾造成癫痫发作、危险的体温过高与死亡。

fact.en: It takes the N-(2-methoxybenzyl) group, the NBOMe tag that makes phenethylamines like 25I-NBOMe extremely potent, and attaches it to plain tryptamine.
fact.zh: 它把N-(2-甲氧基苄基)這個NBOMe標記（正是它讓25I-NBOMe等苯乙胺類變得極為強效）接到最基本的色胺上。
fact.zhHans: 它把N-(2-甲氧基苄基)这个NBOMe标记（正是它让25I-NBOMe等苯乙胺类变得极为强效）接到最基本的色胺上。
